brief: A podcast player where episodes are constellations — listened ones glow, series form patterns

dominant_strengths: Strong conceptual metaphor — episodes as stars and series as constellations creates poetic, memorable identity
Restrained palette of teal/pink/grey on deep navy reads cleanly and supports the cosmic theme
Now Playing card has tidy hierarchy with nice eyebrow label, title, and progress bar
dominant_weaknesses: Constellations feel like random scatter — no readable patterns, named series, or clustering that earn the metaphor
Behavior is opaque: no titles, hover affordances, transport controls, or way to identify which star is which episode
Spatial composition is uneven with empty lower-right quadrant and weak focal hierarchy around the 'Playing' star
fix_priorities: Make constellations legible — group episodes per series with named labels and intentional star shapes
Add interactive affordances: hover reveals episode title, click plays, stronger glow/halo on the active star
Introduce transport controls and skip/scrub in the Now Playing panel for behavioral completeness
Rebalance composition with anchored constellation positions rather than scattered noise
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral wonder and reflective concept dominate while behavioral usability collapses under unlabeled, undifferentiated dots.
rationale.intent_fit: It evokes the constellation metaphor visually but doesn't yet form recognizable patterns or a usable podcast player.
